title: AI Citation Rescue Ledger
oneLiner: A revenue-risk desk that turns AI-search visibility losses into concrete citation, community, and direct-response repair tasks.
signalRefs: 9to5Google: Google Search traffic has plummeted, AI referrals are less than 1%
Reddit r/seodiscovery2026: Is AI Search Reducing Your Organic Traffic Too?
Reddit r/AiForSmallBusiness: small businesses still trying old SEO while traffic falls
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive SaaS operator dashboard called "AI Citation Rescue Ledger" for small publishers and owner-led businesses losing discovery to AI search. The product turns suspected AI-search traffic loss into a weekly repair workflow: traffic loss snapshot, AI citation gaps, missing source proof, community-answer backlog, schema/direct-response checklist, task owners, and exportable client report. Required screens/sections: left navigation, executive risk strip, table of lost topics, citation repair drawer, community proof queue, direct-response backup checklist, 7-day kanban, and report preview. Design direction: use the operator-dense profile with compact tables, strong scanning hierarchy, restrained color, clear risk badges, and pragmatic revenue-ops controls rather than a marketing landing page.
